notes.trap: The default mode is PERMISSIVE, so a field that does not parse into its declared type silently becomes NULL while the other fields of the struct are still filled in. No error is raised even with a wrong schema. The schema argument must be a literal DDL string, not a column.

It infers types from a single CSV line and always names the columns `_c0`, `_c1`, ... because the first line is never treated as a header. The argument must be a foldable string literal, so you cannot pass a table column to it. The result is a DDL string, typically fed to `from_csv(...)`.

A NULL field is written as an empty string (the default nullValue is ''), so a NULL turns into a trailing or embedded empty column instead of the text NULL. The output carries no header and no field names, only the values.
